author: Auralurmah
quote: Gran potencia técnica, admirable, pero se sacrificó cosas importantes, hay bugs en el lanzamiento, historia lenta y genérica que engancha poco, pocas cosas se sienten realmente emocionantes, limitaciones comparándolo con entregas anteriores, sin novedades reales, 30 fps INESTABLES que a veces incomoda en la experiencia de juego.

author: Auralurmah
quote: A well-optimized game with outstanding artistic design in its characters, clothing, and environments. Great controls. Various features, such as the Zelda's Notes app and the use of the microphone to play melodies, further enhance the gaming experience. New gameplay mechanics offer a fresh experience. A fantastic adventure where everything encourages you to observe and think. It tells a wonderful story that makes you want to keep playing. It also features side quests that allow you to explore and enjoy even more of the game. The artistic work is exquisite, carefully crafted, and clearly made with passion. Without a doubt, a refreshing experience in an industry that has become stagnant.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
